name: Charging Interest
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers not to charge interest, or usury, to their fellow Israelites, especially those who are poor or in need, emphasizing compassion and mutual support within the community (Exodus 22:25; Leviticus 25:35-36; Deuteronomy 23:19-20). Lending with interest is prohibited among brethren to foster unity and reliance on God’s provision, while lending to strangers with interest is permitted (Deuteronomy 23:20). The psalmist affirms that one who refrains from exploiting others through interest will be firmly established (Psalms 15:5).
